zh: 不知道你能不能帮我看一下这份报告？（委婉请求）
en: I was {wondering} if you could help me with this report.

zh: 我想问问，我们的碰头会能不能改到周四？（委婉商量）
en: I was {wondering} whether we could move our catch-up to Thursday.

zh: 你有空的时候，能麻烦你看一下我的代码吗？
en: Would you {mind} taking a look at my code when you're free?

zh: 你介意我开一下窗吗？这里有点闷。
en: Would you {mind} if I opened the window? It's a bit stuffy in here.

zh: 你能带我过一遍新流程吗？（客气地请求）
en: {Could|Can|Would} you walk me through the new process?

zh: 我可以借用一下你的充电器吗？
en: {Could|Can|May} I borrow your charger for a minute?

zh: 很抱歉，周五的晚饭我恐怕去不了。
en: I'm {afraid|sorry} I can't make it to dinner on Friday.

zh: 不好意思，那件商品目前恐怕没货了。
en: I'm {afraid|sorry} that item is out of stock at the moment.

zh: 也许值得先查一下日志。（委婉建议）
en: It {might|may|could} be worth checking the logs first.

zh: 上线之前，我们也许最好再测一遍。（委婉建议）
en: We {might|may} want to test this again before we go live.

zh: 就问一个小问题：备用钥匙放在哪儿？
en: Just a {quick|small} question: where do you keep the spare keys?

zh: 你今天下午有空简单聊几句吗？
en: Have you got time for a {quick|short|brief} chat this afternoon?

zh: 不好意思打扰你，请问你知道会议室在哪儿吗？
en: Sorry to {bother|trouble|disturb} you, but do you know where the meeting room is?

zh: 你今天休息，我不想打扰你，所以方便的时候再回复就行。
en: I don't want to {bother|disturb|trouble} you on your day off, so just reply when you can.

zh: 没关系，你慢慢来。
en: No {worries|problem}, take your time.

zh: “对不起，我迟到了！”“没事，我们也才刚开始。”
en: "Sorry I'm late!" "No {worries|problem}, we've only just started."

zh: 我建议我们等测试结果出来再说。（委婉提出意见）
en: I'd {suggest|recommend|propose} we wait until the test results come back.

zh: 你咳成这样，我建议你去看看医生。
en: I'd {suggest|recommend} seeing a doctor about that cough.

zh: 请问你知不知道药店几点关门？（客气地打听）
en: Do you {happen} to know what time the pharmacy closes?

zh: 你该不会碰巧有多余的手机充电器吧？
en: You don't {happen} to have a spare phone charger, do you?

zh: 不好意思，我好像没太听明白。你能把最后那部分再解释一下吗？
en: Sorry, I'm not {sure} I follow. Could you explain that last part again?

zh: 我不太确定这是最好的做法。（委婉表示不同意）
en: I'm not {sure|certain|convinced} that's the best way to do it.

zh: 如果我说错了请纠正我，不过我记得截止日期是下周五。
en: Correct me if I'm {wrong|mistaken}, but I thought the deadline was next Friday.

zh: 我可能说得不对，不过我觉得这趟公交车不在医院停。
en: I could be {wrong|mistaken}, but I think this bus doesn't stop at the hospital.

zh: 请问这双鞋可以退款吗？（客气地询问是否可行）
en: Would it be {possible|okay|OK} to get a refund for these shoes?

zh: 我明白你的出发点，但我还是觉得需要多测试一下。（委婉表示不同意）
en: I see where you're {coming} from, but I still think we need more testing.

zh: 你现在有空吗？打印机这边我需要你帮个忙。
en: Do you have a {minute|moment|second|sec}? I need a hand with the printer.

zh: 抱歉打断一下，有你的电话。
en: Sorry to {interrupt|butt in|cut in}, but there's a call for you.

zh: 上周末你帮我搬家，我真的很感激。
en: I really {appreciate} your help with the move last weekend.

zh: 如果你们晚上十点以后能小声一点，我会非常感激。
en: I'd {appreciate} it if you could keep the noise down after ten.

zh: 谢谢你告诉我封路的事。
en: Thanks for {letting} me know about the road closure.

zh: 冰箱里的东西你随便拿，别客气。
en: Feel {free} to grab anything from the fridge.

zh: 说实话，我更喜欢原来的设计。（委婉表达真实想法）
en: To be {honest|fair|frank}, I preferred the old design.

zh: 不着急，你方便的时候再回复我就行。
en: No {rush|hurry}, just get back to me when you can.

zh: 你有空的时候能帮我核对一下工时表吗？
en: Could you check my timesheet when you get a {chance|moment|minute|second}?

zh: 要在周五前做完可能有点难。（委婉地说有困难）
en: That might be a {bit|little|tad} tricky to finish by Friday.

zh: 我明白你的意思，不过我觉得这周上线风险太大。
en: I see your {point}, but I think it's too risky to launch this week.

zh: 你说得有道理。我之前没考虑到成本。
en: That's a fair {point|comment}. I hadn't thought about the cost.

zh: 恕我直言，我觉得这不是客户想要的。
en: With all due {respect}, I don't think that's what the customer asked for.

zh: 可能是我没搞明白，不过我们为什么需要两个不同的登录账号？
en: I may be {missing} something, but why do we need two separate logins?

zh: 你方便顺路把我送到火车站吗？
en: Would you be {able|willing|happy} to drop me at the station on your way?

zh: 抱歉回复晚了，我前几天请病假了。
en: Sorry for the late {reply|response}, I've been off sick.

zh: 请稍等一下，我找找您的预订记录。
en: {Bear} with me for a second while I find your booking.

zh: 我的账单好像有个错误。（委婉指出问题）
en: There {seems|appears} to be a mistake on my bill.

zh: 也许我们下次可以试试另一家咖啡馆？
en: {Maybe|Perhaps} we could try the other cafe next time?

zh: 要不要我回家路上顺便买点面包？
en: Would you {like|want} me to pick up some bread on the way home?

zh: 先谢谢你的帮忙了。
en: Thanks in {advance} for your help.

zh: 我很想去，可是那天晚上我已经有安排了。（委婉拒绝）
en: I'd {love|like} to come, but I've already got plans that night.

zh: 打扰一下，请问这个座位有人吗？
en: {Excuse|Pardon} me, is this seat taken?

zh: 不好意思，我刚才没听清。你能再说一遍吗？
en: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it {again|once more}?
